title: The Long Watch
summary: Osric Hale says a Watch post is a place you stand when nobody comes to relieve you. Hold the Toadking's Mound that long, and he'll teach your fighters to get their breath back (the fighter's level-12 skill).

steps.journal: Go down to Toadking's Mound's second floor and hold its last hall, the one with the stairs down, for ten waves.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Mound's hall

ready: Go back to Osric Hale at his Watch post in Thornwick.
done: Osric taught your fighters Second Wind, and wrote down that he had.
